name: SuperLite 3in1 Series: Tsuri shuu
summary:
Superlite 3 in 1 - Series Tsuri Shuu is a compilation of 3 fishing games released for the PlayStation console:
- Fishing Club - Boat no Tsuriken: (The Boat Fishing) In this game the player go fishing using a boat.
- Fishing Club - Bouhatei no Tsuriken: (The Breakwater fishing) In this game the player can go fishing in docks near the sea.
- Fishing Club - Hama no Tsuriken: (The beach fishing) In this game the player can go fishing in beaches.
